title: Cracking Deep Learning
blurb: Build the layers behind modern networks by hand in NumPy: activations, losses, initialisation, normalisation and backprop, then CNN, RNN and transformer blocks, and the pieces of autoencoders, VAEs and GANs. Every problem pins down shapes and conventions the way a framework does.
prereq: Fluent Python and NumPy broadcasting, the chain rule, and matrix products; the Cracking ML and Calculus plans cover the groundwork.
next: Go deeper into language or vision with the NLP and computer vision problems, or move on to diffusion and flow-matching models, which reuse the U-Net, attention and normalisation blocks practised here.
